Uses the shared species and weight above. Workbook profiles & clinical references.

Best use: Prokinetic/antiemetic support when appropriate; exclude GI obstruction, perforation or hemorrhage. Veterinary reference.

Assumed dose: 2 mg/kg/day · daily dose scales to preparation duration. No SQ or loading dose included here; single SQ calculator remains in Drugs.
